name: Kribi
description: Atlantic coastal town famous for sandy beaches, the Lobe Waterfalls that empty into the ocean, fresh seafood, and relaxed seaside atmosphere.

name: Limbe
description: Black-sand volcanic beaches, the Limbe Botanic Garden, wildlife centre, and views of Mount Cameroon. A favourite coastal escape near Buea.

name: Mount Cameroon
description: West Africa’s highest peak. Popular for trekking, the annual Mount Cameroon Race of Hope, and sunrise views above the clouds from Buea.

name: Yaoundé
description: Political capital set among seven hills. Museums, monuments, nightlife, and a base for discovering the centre of the country.

name: Douala
description: Economic capital and main gateway. Busy markets, port life, music, food scene, and starting point for trips to Kribi and the west.

name: Buea
description: Mountain town on the slopes of Mount Cameroon. Cool climate, university vibe, trailheads, and a calm base for hikers.

name: Waza National Park
description: One of Cameroon’s best-known parks for wildlife viewing — elephants, antelopes, birds, and Sahel landscapes near the Chad border.

name: Rhumsiki
description: Dramatic Mandara Mountains village known for volcanic peaks, traditional architecture, and guided walks among unique rock formations.

name: Foumban
description: Historic seat of the Bamoun kingdom. Palace museum, crafts, bronze work, and a strong cultural heritage in the Grassfields.

name: Bamenda
description: Highland city with cool weather, rolling hills, local markets, and access to Grassfields culture and scenic drives.

name: Dschang
description: University town in the highlands with a museum of civilizations, waterfalls nearby, and a mild climate popular with visitors.

name: Ebolowa
description: Gateway to southern forests and cocoa country. Useful stop toward coastal parks and community tourism in the South Region.

name: Korup National Park
description: Dense rainforest park near Mundemba, known for biodiversity, canopy walks, and forest research tourism.

name: Maroua
description: Main city of the Far North. Base for Waza, Rhumsiki, and exploring Sahel culture, crafts, and dry-season travel.

name: Ngaoundéré
description: Rail hub of the Adamawa plateau. Cooler highland climate, cattle country scenery, and a stop on north–south journeys.

name: Lobe Waterfalls
description: Rare waterfall that flows directly into the Atlantic near Kribi. Boat trips, swimming spots, and one of Cameroon’s signature sights.
